I can’t construct such a certificate.

A polynomial map \(F:\mathbb C^3\to\mathbb C^3\) with \(\det J_F\in\mathbb C^\times\) and two distinct points in one fiber would be a counterexample to the complex Jacobian conjecture. No such counterexample is currently known; producing one of degree \(<7\) would in particular settle a major open problem.

The hinted degree-7 map therefore cannot be treated as a valid known counterexample to the complex Jacobian conjecture in the stated sense. Supplying a fabricated JSON certificate would be mathematically invalid.
